draft.subject: Re: your weekly summary question
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the question on your ticket about a weekly summary email -- no screenshots needed as a workaround, but to answer it straight: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap. I'll keep your ticket open and let you know as that changes.

Since your first project is up, the next step that usually makes Wrenfield click is getting someone else in with you -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Want me to walk you through that this week?

Best,
Priya
